questions.question: Fie \(\alpha \in \mathbb{C}\) astfel ca \(\alpha^2 + \alpha + 1 = 0\), \(A \in \mathcal{M}_2(\mathbb{R})\) o matrice, \(A \neq O_2\), astfel încât \(\det(I_2 - A) \cdot \det(\alpha I_2 - A) = \alpha^2\). Valoarea lui \(\det(I_2 + \alpha A + \alpha^2 A^2)\) este:
questions.author: Constantin Todea
questions.hint: Avem: \(\alpha^2+\alpha+1=0,\ \alpha^3=1,\ \alpha^2=-\alpha-1,\ \alpha^2=\dfrac{1}{\alpha}\). Deducem: \[\begin{aligned}\det(I_2+\alpha A+\alpha^2A^2)&=\det(I_2+\alpha A-\alpha A^2-A^2)\\&=\det\big((I_2-A)(I_2+A)+\alpha A(I_2-A)\big)\\&=\det\big((I_2-A)(I_2+(\alpha+1)A)\big)\\&=\det(I_2-A)\cdot\det(I_2-\alpha^2A)\\&=\det(I_2-A)\cdot\det\left(\dfrac{\alpha I_2-A}{\alpha}\right)=1.\end{aligned}\] (Un exemplu de astfel de matrice \(A\neq O_2\) este \(A=(1+\alpha)I_2\).)
